cases.d: Turn on Voice ID with consent and record voice samples.
steps: Open Giọng nói của tôi and read the notice (Mục đích, Lưu gì, Dùng ở đâu, Quyền của bạn, Bên kiểm soát dữ liệu).
Tick the consent statement and click "Đồng ý và bật".
Click "Ghi giọng mẫu", read the text, click "Dừng và lưu"; record a second sample.
exp: Without ticking, Voice ID cannot be turned on.
After consent the status is "Đang bật".
Each good sample is listed; a bad one (noise, two voices) is refused with the reason.

cases.d: Turn Voice ID off and erase the samples.
steps: Click to turn off Voice ID and confirm "Tắt và xoá".
exp: "Tắt nhận diện giọng nói?" is asked first.
The samples are erased; automatic speaker suggestions for this user stop.
Names the Secretary already assigned in transcripts stay.
pre: Voice ID is on with samples.

steps: Click "Xoá giọng mẫu" on one sample and confirm.
exp: "Đã xoá giọng mẫu." appears and the sample leaves the list.
With fewer than 2 samples the page asks to record more.
pre: Voice ID is on with two samples.
